description: BC Government Owned and Leased Buildings Spatial is a dataset listed in British Columbia data catalogue (BC Data Catalogue), an open data portal, published or maintained by Business Intelligence & Project Support. On behalf of the Province of BC and as legislated by the Public Agency Accommodation Act, Real Property Division owned and leases approximately 1,040 building in communities across BC. This spatial layer shows the location of owned and leased buildings throughout the province. Coverage: British Columbia. The portal files it under the publisher Business Intelligence & Project Support. Its tags are ARES, Accommodation and Real Estate Services, BC, Map, Provincial. It offers 1 resource(s) in SHP. The portal shows 2026-07-03 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Access Only. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-bc-portal.
